## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what this change does. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their results, and relevant OS/browser versions.
For documentation changes, describe link and command verification.

## Limits or follow-up work

State what remains untested or unsupported. Include screenshots for visible UI changes
when helpful, with credentials and personal data removed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and unrelated generated/dependency files are excluded.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated, or the reason they are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] No private keys, join links/codes, transfer capabilities, or private files are included.
- [ ] Performance and compatibility claims are supported by the reported evidence.
